children.text: Armenian American composer whose work is often described as documentary composition: music built with and around real testimony, where speaking becomes material and the ensemble becomes a carrier for remembered scenes and aftershock.

She gives us a different kind of “memory form” than Miyamoto or Ibarra because instead of memory held in song tradition or rap world-building, memory arrives through narrated detail and the compositional frame. We’ll focus on her project
and its first movement, “You are not a kid.”
